title: isodon inflexus var. verticillatus
intro: Isodon inflexus var. verticillatus, commonly known as the 'White Stemmed Isodon', is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, which is a type of flowering plant. The White Stemmed Isodon is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Isodon inflexus var. verticillatus include diterpenoid compounds, such as labdane diterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
